# tomswallapi_tc_interface (Resource)

Simple per-interface traffic shaping on a device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_tc_interface" "wan" {
  device        = "fw1"
  interface     = "eth0"
  in_bandwidth  = "100mbit"
  out_bandwidth = "20mbit"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device` (String) Owning device.
- `interface` (String) Interface to shape.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `in_bandwidth` (String) Ingress bandwidth limit (e.g. 100mbit).
- `out_bandwidth` (String) Egress bandwidth (e.g. 100mbit).
- `type` (String) external or internal.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the server-assigned numeric id.
terraform import tomswallapi_tc_interface.wan 42
```
